reason: A client plugin that restores crypto.randomUUID on insecure HTTP origins using crypto.getRandomValues so the web UI can continue issuing RPC requests.

summaries.zh: 在不安全的 HTTP 页面中使用 crypto.getRandomValues 补充 crypto.randomUUID，以兼容 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的客户端请求。
summaries.en: A client plugin that polyfills crypto.randomUUID with crypto.getRandomValues for DeepSeek Harness web interfaces served from insecure HTTP origins.

capabilities: Installs a client-side crypto.randomUUID polyfill at application boot
Uses crypto.getRandomValues to generate UUIDs on insecure origins
